0022600184.text: The San Antonio Spurs (5-2, on a five-game winning streak and 6th in the West) host the Dallas Mavericks (4-3, 10th in the West) in the Spurs' eighth game of the season, with San Antonio 1.5 games back of the Southwest lead and Dallas, which lost its most recent game, 2.5 games back. The Spurs are without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain), while Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Kyrie Irving (knee), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee, strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel, inflammation), and Max Christie (hip) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. San Antonio leads the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after a 122-106 win in Dallas, and the Spurs won the 2025-26 series 4-0.
